text:
Studio Schicketanz, an award-winning architecture and design firm, is excited to announce an opening for a Licensed Architect for a leadership position in the Carmel Studio. 
  
About Our Company
  
Studio Schicketanz is a full-service architectural firm providing a wide range of architecture, planning, and interior design services.
  
- Based      in Carmel, our firm specializes in customized residential architecture and      interiors.
  
- We are      known for environmentally conscious designs and are dedicated to creating      sustainable projects that draw upon the strengths of their surroundings.
  
- All of      our projects seamlessly merge interior design, architecture, and the      exterior spaces beyond.
  
- The      Senior Architect is a project leadership position with responsibility for      architectural design and overall project coordination.
 
Job Responsibilities
  
- Provide      project leadership from design through construction.
  
- Oversee      architectural design, documentation, and coordinate technical development      and production with the Bangalore Studio.
  
- Develop      in-house design proposals and lead client presentations.
  
- Establish      project priorities, delegate responsibilities, and monitor team      performance and deadlines.
  
- Coordinate      with outside consultants on project-related work, proposals, and      deliverables.
  
- Coordinate      with Contractors on project management, bidding, construction      administration, and payment applications.
  
- Coordinate      with the Design Team and Permit Processor as part of in-house project      management.
  
- Maintain      clear and effective communication with clients throughout the project.
  
- Manage      project schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
  
- Conduct      periodic site visits and help resolve field conditions and construction      issues.
  
- Manage      project documentation, online and paper filing, and office standards.
  
- Serve      as a point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors, and      internal team members.
 
Leadership Qualifications
  
- Proven      ability to lead and mentor Architects and Designers and foster a      collaborative, productive team environment.
  
- Demonstrated      experience managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  
- Strong      ability to delegate responsibilities, establish expectations, and hold      team members accountable for deadlines and quality.
  
- Experience      serving as the primary architectural lead and point of contact for      clients, consultants, and contractors.
  
- Strong      client-management skills with the ability to confidently lead      presentations, meetings, and project discussions.
  
- Ability      to make sound design and technical decisions and provide clear direction      to project teams.
  
- Strong      problem-solving skills and the ability to resolve project challenges in a      timely and professional manner.
  
- Demonstrated      ability to manage projects from concept through construction while      maintaining design quality, schedule, and budget.
  
- Minimum      5 years of experience in a project leadership or senior architectural role      preferred.
 
Key Skills & Qualifications
  
- California      architectural license required.
  
- Proficiency      in Revit required.
  
- Bachelor's      degree in Architecture required; Master's degree preferred.
  
- LEED      certification preferred.
  
- Strong      leadership, organizational, communication, technical, and graphic skills.
  
- Proficient      in Microsoft Office.
  
- Strong      understanding of residential architectural design, documentation, and      construction.
  
- Excellent      written and verbal communication skills.
  
- Ability      to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, creative, and highly      collaborative environment.
 
If you would like to join a dynamic, energized, innovative, and collaborative environment where your ideas will be heard and your skills challenged, please send your cover letter and resume. No phone calls, please.
  
 
Please email resume to [email protected]
